text:
priya: Heads-up: execs want a single-page pilot definition for Optimize toolkit that callers can hand to customers. We need scope, telemetry, privacy, and billing notes.
sam: Suggest we split into three "shipables" for alpha: 1) read-only recommendations UI (batching/caching/quant) + CSV export, 2) eval-trigger alerts to webhook with noise controls, 3) telemetry + feature flags for org-level opt-in/out.
leah: New ask from compliance: data residency and prompt retention policy. For alpha we should send hashed prompt ids in alerts and keep raw prompts only if customer retention setting >= 30d. Document this clearly.
tony: Ops note: any recommendation that changes request paths (enable batching/prefix cache) can affect billing meters. Need to surface estimated token-savings and an "estimated monthly impact" in the rec card.
priya: Good call. Also include a short paragraph in pilot docs about chargeback: recommended config doesn't auto-change billing; customer must opt-in.
sam: Implementation detail: rec engine will produce confidence (0-1), estimated_token_savings_per_100k, and a simple reason string. CSV export should include route, rec_type, confidence, est_savings, and suggestions.
leah: Privacy: alert payload must have hashed_prompt_id + trace_link. Raw prompt stored only if customer retention >= requested retention and in region. Otherwise store only embeddings for eval replay.
tony: On telemetry: expose metrics: batch_size_p50/p95, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence, est_token_savings. Add a billing view that maps est_savings to $ estimate using account pricing tier.
priya: Pilot acceptance checklist (alpha):
- Recommendations UI with CSV export present
- Eval alerts to webhook with debounce and human-readable "why"
- Org-level feature flag to opt-in/out (console + API)
- Telemetry visible in console metrics and billing estimate shown on rec card
- Privacy controls documented (hashed ids, retention knobs)

sam: Debounce policy idea: alerts only after 3 failing eval runs in a 72h window OR metric delta sustained for 12h. Include reason and confidence in payload.
leah: Also add a QA harness: a fake-eval mode so pilot customers can run the alert logic against a small synthetic eval set to preview noise before enabling.
tony: Risk: customers flip feature and see unexpected costs or latency regressions. Mitigation: show "estimated performance delta" and require explicit confirmation modal listing risk. Also provide a one-click rollback that restores prior route config and pins no-quant metadata.
priya: Docs item: quick rollback CLI + console would be required. Example snippet for CLI:
```
redwood routes update --route my-route --set-metadata '{"optimize_advisor":"off"}'
```
sam: Engineering tasks: rec engine CSV export (3d), webhook + debounce (4d), feature flag API (2d), billing estimate integration (5d), CSV template in console (2d).
leah: Compliance tasks: retention doc + residency mapping (4d), hashed_id scheme spec (2d), QA harness guide (3d).
tony: Ops tasks: create billing tile and preflight check that simulates est_savings impact (5d). Also add an "advisor-impact" dashboard widget.
priya: Timeline proposal: prototype week (1w) -> console + webhook (1w) -> docs + QA harness (4d) -> alpha onboard (2w). Gate to beta: 0 P0 regressions in alpha + pilot customers confirm billing calc within +/-20% of measured.
sam: I'll line up pilot customers; prefer ones with diverse workloads (short-chat, long-doc, streaming).
leah: For the webhook contract, include both a short "why" and a machine-readable reason_code. E.g., reason_code: CACHE_HIGH_PREFIX_REUSE.
priya: Action items: sam confirm pilots (2d), sam + leah draft webhook schema (2d), sam + tony wire billing calc (3d), priya own sign-off. Reconvene in 48h for status. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy notice: branch optimize-instrumentation/alpha -> staged ; smoke tests queued :gear:
